query: INSERT INTO whatsapp_external_message(binding_id,person_id,source_id,origin,source_at,content_revision,deleted_at,revision_content,revised_at) VALUES($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9) ON CONFLICT(binding_id,person_id,source_id) DO UPDATE SET deleted_at=COALESCE(whatsapp_external_message.deleted_at,excluded.deleted_at),revision_content=CASE WHEN excluded.content_revision>whatsapp_external_message.content_revision THEN excluded.revision_content ELSE whatsapp_external_message.revision_content END,revised_at=CASE WHEN excluded.content_revision>whatsapp_external_message.content_revision THEN excluded.revised_at ELSE whatsapp_external_message.revised_at END,content_revision=GREATEST(whatsapp_external_message.content_revision,excluded.content_revision)
